title: NL Task Notified Pull (eOverdracht alignment, POC)
description: Broad, long-lived per-partner subscription on COW Coordination Task changes, per the GF Clinical Workflow profile: each Task change at the Placer notifies the Fulfiller named in Task.owner. Payload mode id-only; the notification carries only the (opaque) Task reference — meaning, retrieval and permission live in the workflow and data layers. Placeholder canonical: topic ownership and base URL are an open working-group question.

resourceTrigger.description: Create or update of a COW Coordination Task carrying task-code fulfill plus a use-case code (e.g. the eOverdracht nursing handoff code), addressed to a partner via Task.owner.

canFilterBy.description: The Fulfiller organisation the Task addresses (URA identifier on Task.owner). Sender-addressed interest direction: one permanent subscription per partner, filtered on owner.
The use-case code on Task.code (second coding next to task-code fulfill), e.g. an eOverdracht/SNOMED code.
